verdict.rationale: Evidence documents Bento's Events API, Subscribers API, webhooks, and SDKs, and even mentions tying revenue back to emails/flows, but nowhere is there a documented endpoint or report for pulling campaign/flow performance metrics (opens, clicks, conversion rates, etc.) into an external warehouse or dashboard. No OpenAPI spec or stats endpoint is evidenced (bento-probe-3 shows no OpenAPI spec found), so this specific capability is unevidenced.
